messages:
tanya: heads-up bringing straylight22b-int6 canary. small perf win but weird chain-of-thought coherence drop on multi-step planning tasks (EM 71 -> 64). posting quick notes.
kevin: run id and config?
tanya: run stray-canary-6189, config: batch=6 microbatch=400k prefetch=on max_new_tokens=256 quant=int6-perchannel calibrator=mae-only
li: paste eval summary?
tanya: eval id eval-stray-6189:
```
./eval.sh --model straylight22b-int6 --suite planning --split test --run-id eval-stray-6189
Total: 1000
ExactMatch: 64.3
Baseline(fp16): 71.0
p50 latency: 98ms (fp16 130ms)
p95 latency: 250ms
No OOMs in baseline run, but sporadic correctness drops on 3+ step chains.
```
kevin: latency win is great but quality gap is alarming. any kernel warnings or fallback?
tanya: yes one kernel message seen in traces:
```
[2026-03-24T09:12:01Z] WARN kernel-selector: fallback to gemm-slim for layer 14 due to alignment
```
li: fallback + quantization can change accumulation order. can you dump logits for failing examples and tokenization boundaries?
tanya: attached a short repro. example:
"""
Prompt: Plan how to schedule 3 meetings across 3 time zones with constraints A,B,C. Provide step-by-step schedule.
int6: output misses a constraint in step 2 and proposes overlapping times
fp16: correct schedule
"""
kevin: two-pronged triage:
1) try layer-protect last3 layers fp16 to see if head is sensitive
2) re-run calibration using KL+MSE and include planning/cot prompts (we only used mae before)
li: ops: can we A/B route 15% to layer-protect and 15% to recalib?
ops-bot: canary deploy initiated: stray-canary-6189 -> nodes [gpu-f2-04,gpu-f2-05], routing layer-protect=15%, recalib-variant=15%, int6-base=70%, trace-sample=1%
kevin: also try lowering default max_new_tokens to 180 for the canary; long chains amplify rounding and kv accumulation errors.
tanya: on it. patching route defaults: max_new_tokens=180. infra patch rolling.
ops-bot: route defaults patched, rolling restart nodes [gpu-f2-04,gpu-f2-05]
li: we saw memory churn for another int6 model with microbatch=400k; suggest reducing microbatch->256k for canary to reduce ephemeral fragmentation. can we do that too?
kevin: yes do microbatch 256k for layer-protect variant and keep recalib variant at 400k so experiments are orthogonal.
ops-bot: updating configs: layer-protect: microbatch=256k, max_new_tokens=180; recalib-variant: microbatch=400k, calibrator=kl+mse; rolling restart.

After 45m:
tanya: early results:
- layer-protect last3: ExactMatch planning = 69.5 (close to fp16 71.0), p50 latency +12ms
- recalib (kl+mse): ExactMatch planning = 66.8, p50 latency unchanged
- int6-base: 64.3
kevin: good signal that head layers matter. what's the kernel fallback behavior now?
tanya: fallback warnings dropped after pinning kernel image on both canary nodes. ops-bot pinned gpu-f2-04->matmul-v5, gpu-f2-05->matmul-v5.
ops-bot: kernel pin applied, node images consistent.
li: any OOMs or mem-frag alerts with these settings?
tanya: mem-frag logs show free-list peaks ~620MB but soft-evict reclaimed enough. no OOMs. sample logs:
```
[09:57:10] INFO evict: reclaimed 280MB
[09:57:20] WARN mem-frag: free-list peaks 620MB after gc
```
kevin: plan going forward:
- adopt layer-protect last3 as interim default for straylight int6 (warm rollout)
- finish full recalib with per-channel+kl+mse including planning/COT prompts; if it reaches >=70 EM, consider switching to recalib instead of layer-protect
- keep microbatch 256k for traffic-sensitive variants, allow 400k for recalib testing
- keep max_new_tokens default 180 for canary routes until stability
- add 'planning-exact' eval gate to onboarding checklist (3pt regression cap)
- surface kernel-fallback alerts as SLO incidents for canary nodes
li: also add a quick lint: ensure calibrator includes representative multi-step prompts for any new large model. avoids repeated surprises.
tanya: updating runbook and will open PR to add planning/COT prompts to the calibration corpus. will also attach failing traces to the ticket. ping me if you want raw logs.
kevin: thanks all. if quality holds for 6h with layer-protect, start a measured warm rollout to 30% and monitor multistep-exact and latency p95.
ops-bot: warm rollout scheduled: increase layer-protect traffic by 5% every 30m until 30% with rollback on >3pt regression.
